experiment_c_claims_verification.preferred_scientific_interpretation: FedProx substantially reduced measured client drift (-63.69%) while maintaining comparable aggregate segmentation performance, with modest TC/ET improvements and a small WT trade-off.
experiment_c_claims_verification.runtime_overhead_assessment: Negligible observed runtime overhead in this experiment (+3.08s over 5.71 hours).

sample_level_dp_sgd.details: Batch/sample-level gradient norm clipping and calibrated Gaussian noise injection with RDP accounting.

privacy_accountant_rdp.details: Analytical Rényi Differential Privacy conversion to (ε, δ)-DP over orders alpha in [1.1, 64].

opacus_integration.details: Opacus package not installed; native analytical RDP accountant handles budget calculation.

homomorphic_encryption_ckks.details: Chunked CKKS vector encryption, homomorphic weighted addition, and vector decryption.

secure_aggregation_protocol.details: Diffie-Hellman / Shamir pairwise masking wrapper structure.

actual_privacy_guarantee.protected_entity: Individual patient subject scans in hospital local datasets (sample-level privacy)
actual_privacy_guarantee.clipping_mechanism: L2 gradient norm clipping: g = g / max(1, ||g||_2 / C)
actual_privacy_guarantee.clipped_quantity: Total gradient vector g across all 4,810,074 trainable parameters
actual_privacy_guarantee.noise_distribution: Calibrated Zero-Mean Gaussian: N(0, (sigma * C)^2 * I)
actual_privacy_guarantee.formal_accounting_method: Exact Analytical Rényi Differential Privacy (Poisson RDP)

selection.rationale: 1. Single-Variable Scientific Isolation: Adding DP to FedAvg isolates the exact privacy perturbation penalty Delta_DP = Utility(FedAvg) - Utility(FedAvg+DP) without confounding interactions with FedProx's proximal term. 2. Literature Standardization: DP-FedAvg (McMahan et al. 2018) is the standard canonical benchmark in FL privacy. 3. Clean Baseline: Allows pure attribution of noise-induced degradation vs baseline FedAvg performance.
selection.future_extension: FedProx+DP (Experiment F / compound baseline) will be benchmarked subsequently to assess whether proximal regularization mitigates DP noise drift.
